items.title: Reading and Managing Privacy Policies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Reading and Managing Privacy Policies (PDF 124, printed 120).

blocks.text: Privacy policy batati hai ke website ya app aap ki maloomat kaise jama karti, rakhti aur use karti hai. Account banane ya terms se ittefaq karne se pehle inhein ghaur se parhna zaroori hai. Yeh policies dekh kar user faisla kar sakta hai ke zaati data share kare ya nahi. Talaba yeh check karna seekhte hain ke kis qism ka data aur kis maqsad ke liye jama ho raha hai. Privacy ko zimmedari se sambhalne se zaati tafseel ijazat ke baghair share nahi hoti. Privacy policy users ko batati hai ke un ka data kaise jama, use, store aur share hota hai. Misal: kisi bhi social platform par sign up karte waqt privacy policy batati hai ke kaun sa data jama ho sakta hai, jaise naam, email address, location, browsing activity aur app ka istemal. Yeh bhi bata sakti hai ke yeh data advertisers ya third-party services (doosri companiyon) ko diya jata hai ya nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Settings ko baqaida dekhte rehna aap ki hifazat yaqeeni banata hai, kyunke platforms apne features badalte rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Social app ki privacy policy parhte waqt kin do baaton par khaas nazar rakhni chahiye?
blocks.explanation: (1) Kaun sa data jama hota hai (naam, email, location, browsing activity, app usage) aur kis maqsad ke liye. (2) Kya yeh data advertisers ya third-party services ke saath share hota hai.

items: Privacy policy: website ya app aap ka data kaise jama, use, store aur share karti hai.
Account banane ya terms manne se pehle parhein.
